ComfyUI – Simple & Basic Image Workflow 🎨

An easy-to-use workflow for image generation:
• text2image
• LoRA support
• ControlNet
• wildcards support 📜

Perfect for beginners.📚

📃Notes
⚠️ If wildcards are NOT enabled, write your positive and negative prompts in the bottom fields, not the top ones.

✍🏻 📃Safe rule

✅ With wildcards:
Positive → TOP || Negative → also TOP

✅ Without wildcards:
Positive → BOTTOM || Negative → BOTTOM

🔛 Example for Ksmaplers 🔛

This setup may produce images with a slight anime-style look, similar to the showcase image.

⚠️ Note: If anatomical errors occur, tweak the HiresFix percentage (usually lowering it helps).
